mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of accelerating industrial production (INDPRO above 100 and rising), manufacturing output growth signals strong economic activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 100 and rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2% (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining housing starts (HOUST below 1000 thousand units), weak housing market conditions suppress consumer confidence and retail activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.
